title: The Salt of the Sundered Sea Anew
premise: In the salt-locked city of Vessamare, where magic was outlawed after the Sundering, Xanthe Oyelaran hides his gift as a cartographer of realms that exist only beyond the veil—until the old gods, long silent, begin answering prayers again, and every answered prayer leaves a hollowed worshipper behind. When King Aldric begins speaking in a voice that is not his own, Xanthe is drawn into a conspiracy among exiled priests, smuggler-priestesses, and the god Ossuar, who wears the crown like a puppeteer's hand. To free the king, Xanthe must map the god's true name across the sundered sea itself, sacrificing the anonymity he built his survival on—and part of his own memory of who he was before Vessamare. In the end he unbinds Aldric at the cost of the maps that made him himself, choosing to remain in a city that will never know what it owes him.
about_author: Ines Eriksen is the pen name of a former maritime archivist who spent a decade cataloguing charts of coastlines that no longer exist. They write fantasy about people who survive by being overlooked, and live somewhere within sight of cold water.

chapters.title: Charms for the Godless
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. He sells a luck-knot to a dockworker in Vessamare's night market, hiding his cartographic gift behind small, deniable charms. A woman begs him to bless her dying son; he refuses, terrified. Emotional beat: the loneliness of enforced invisibility, and the first crack in it—the boy recovers anyway, whispering a god's name.

chapters.title: The Answering
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Rumors spread of prayers answered across the city: bread multiplying, fevers breaking, then worshippers found hollow-eyed and silent. Xanthe recognizes the pattern from an old chart he drew of the Sundered Sea. Emotional beat: dread dawning—he knows what answers prayers here, and it isn't kind.

chapters.title: A Map of What Was Drowned
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. He unrolls his forbidden masterwork—a chart of the pre-Sundering sea—to find the god's name inked where no city stood. Someone is watching through the window. Emotional beat: the thrill and terror of touching his true craft again after three years of hiding.

chapters.title: The Priestess of Salt Row
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. Sefa, a smuggler-priestess of the outlawed tide-cult, confronts Xanthe, having traced the recovered boy's miracle to his charms. She offers alliance: she knows the rituals, he can navigate the unmapped realms. Emotional beat: wary mutual recognition between two people surviving by disguise.

chapters.title: What Wears the Crown
chapters.summary: Aldric's POV. King Aldric wakes in his own body only minutes at a time, watching from inside as something ancient signs his decrees and smiles with his mouth. He scratches a plea into the palace wall. Emotional beat: horror and fading hope as his self erodes hour by hour.

chapters.title: The Hollow Congregation
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. Sefa leads Xanthe into a shrine where answered prayers have emptied forty worshippers, their devotion harvested. Among them: the dockworker from chapter one. Emotional beat: grief hardening into resolve; the price of the gods' return made flesh.

chapters.title: Ossuar Speaks
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. The god contacts Xanthe directly through a dream-chart, offering him anything—his lost family, his erased past—if he stops interfering. It shows him a memory he doesn't remember having. Emotional beat: temptation that cuts to the bone of identity.

chapters.title: The Cartographer's Debt
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Flashback woven with present action: how Xanthe survived the Sundering purges by trading away pieces of his own history to a memory-broker. Each charm he sells is paid for with a forgotten year. Emotional beat: understanding the full price of his survival.

chapters.title: Breaking Into the Palace
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. Sefa, Xanthe, and her crew infiltrate the palace during a tide-festival to reach Aldric, navigating servant passages Xanthe maps in real time with his gift. Emotional beat: exhilaration of using his power openly for the first time—and the risk it invites.

chapters.title: The King in the Wall
chapters.summary: Aldric's POV. The conspirators find Aldric's scratched plea; the king, briefly himself, begs them to kill him if they cannot free him. Guards close in. Emotional beat: desperate humanity in a man being devoured, and the crew's vow to try the impossible instead.

chapters.title: Betrayal on Salt Row
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. One of Sefa's crew sells them out to the Crown's witch-hunters to save his own daughter from the hollowing. Sefa is captured; Xanthe escapes with half the ritual text. Emotional beat: rage and heartbreak—the corrupting arithmetic of survival.

chapters.title: Interrogation of the Tide-Cult
chapters.summary: Aldric's POV (flickering). The possessed king personally interrogates Sefa, and for one lucid minute Aldric slips her a hint about the god's binding-place before Ossuar slams him under again. Emotional beat: a prisoner helping a prisoner, both wearing masks.

chapters.title: The Unmapped Realm
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. To complete the ritual he must enter the realm beyond the veil he has only ever charted from afar—a place shaped by memory. Inside, he meets the versions of himself he sold away. Emotional beat: confronting the stranger he became to stay alive.

chapters.title: Negotiating with a God
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Ossuar offers a final bargain: leave Aldric bound and the god will return everything Xanthe sold, whole. Xanthe sees the trap—restored memories would make him someone who would never have come this far. Emotional beat: refusing wholeness to keep his purpose.

chapters.title: Riot of the Answered
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV (from her cell) and city-wide scope. The hollowed worshippers rise as Ossuar's army; Vessamare burns its own temples in panic. Sefa escapes in the chaos with help from the traitor's guilt-ridden daughter. Emotional beat: a city discovering that salvation has a body count.

chapters.title: The Name Beneath the Sea
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. At the drowned pre-Sundering harbor, Xanthe begins mapping Ossuar's true name onto the living water, each stroke costing him another memory—this time chosen, not stolen. Emotional beat: reclaiming agency over the price of power.

chapters.title: Storm Over Vessamare
chapters.summary: Multiple POVs converging. Ossuar, feeling the unbinding begin, floods the city with the sea itself; Sefa fights toward the harbor through the drowning streets while Aldric wrestles the god from inside. Emotional beat: everything converging, everyone spending what they have left.

chapters.title: The Unbinding
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Climax. On the flooded quay, Xanthe completes the name and Ossuar tears itself out of Aldric—but the god seizes Xanthe's remaining memories as it goes, offering one last trade. Xanthe lets it take everything, including his name for himself. Emotional beat: sacrifice as the ultimate act of self-definition.

chapters.title: A Man Without a Chart
chapters.summary: Aldric's POV. Freed and broken, Aldric finds Xanthe wandering the drained streets, unable to remember why he came. Aldric kneels to a commoner and promises the city will remember—even if Xanthe cannot. Emotional beat: grace offered to someone who can't recognize it.

chapters.title: What Sefa Kept
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. Sefa takes Xanthe in, teaching him himself piece by piece: his hands remember drawing, his voice remembers her name. She shows him one thing she stole back from the god—a single chart, unsigned. Emotional beat: love as an act of restoration.

chapters.title: The First New Map
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Magic remains outlawed, but Aldric quietly commissions a new office: cartographers of the unmapped realms. Xanthe, still missing most of his past, draws his first chart of the world as it now is—not what was lost. Emotional beat: building identity forward instead of backward.

chapters.title: Salt and Sunrise
chapters.summary: Ensemble coda. On the rebuilt seawall, Xanthe, Sefa, and Aldric watch the tide come in over the sundered sea. Somewhere far out, something old stirs but does not answer. Xanthe signs his new map with a mark he doesn't remember inventing. Emotional beat: quiet, earned peace—with the price of survival written in salt.
